answers.answer: Revenue decreased by $2,878,382 thousand, or 23% (from $12,305,539 to $9,427,157). The company says this was mainly because of weaker macroeconomic trends. The effect was strongest in Industrial, where customers reduced their inventory balances, and in Communications, mainly because of the timing of infrastructure deployment cycles. Automotive and Consumer fell less, as demand weakened with reduced consumer spending. Revenue fell in all regions because of the weaker macroeconomic conditions.
